settings.title: Settings

email-change.title: Change Email
email-change.description: Changing your email address will update the address used for notifications and other account-related actions. We'll send a verification email to your new address.

success-message.description: We've sent a verification link to {email}. Once you click the link, your email address will be updated

account-deletion.title: Delete Account
account-deletion.description: This action is irreversible and will permanently delete all your data. A confirmation email will be sent to your registered email address to finalize the account deletion process.

confirmation-link-sent.description: We've sent a confirmation link to your email. Please click the link to permanently delete your account

account-deleted.title: Account deleted
account-deleted.description: Your account and all associated data have been permanently deleted

deletion-failed.description: An error occurred while trying to delete your account. Please try again

workspace-url-change.title: Change Workspace URL
workspace-url-change.description: This will replace all your workspace URLs and the old ones will redirect automatically.

workspace-invitation.title: Invite to Your Workspace
workspace-invitation.description: Send an invitation to new members to join your workspace.
